notes: Initial run is intentionally 10 minutes; change only duration_minutes after the proof passes.
The workflow must use the standard public-repository ubuntu-latest runner, never a paid larger runner.
No external LLM/API is required for v0.1; movement and battle probing are driven from RPG Maker MV runtime state plus real Playwright keyboard input.
Duration alone is not gameplay verification. Progress, battle return-to-map, fatal stops and stalls are recorded separately.
